cohort: 1,374 children participating in the Allergic Rhinitis Cohort Study for kids (ARCO-kids study)
finding: Long-term breastfeeding (≥12 months) and vaginal delivery are independently associated with a lower risk of developing childhood allergic rhinitis, and the combination of both factors further reduces the risk.
mod_finding: Children born via Cesarean section had a higher prevalence of allergic rhinitis compared to those born vaginally.
